verdict.rationale: Virtualization and container support is a fair question for a developer-facing chip, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions virtualization, hypervisors, VMs, or Docker. The only related items are Xcode simulators and build speed, which are a different capability and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, VMs and containers run well on this silicon — documented virtualization support and mainstream hypervisor and Docker workflows
